notes.title: Version 0.1.2 Update of "Fall"
notes.notes:
《审判》模式
由于玩家反馈该模式太肝，每次产出新武器或角色需要耗费大量时间，从而影响心情及游戏体验，现决定做出以下调整。
1、大幅度降低所有武器获取难度，提升游戏体验。
2、大幅度降低所有角色获取难度，提升游戏体验。

"Judgment" Mode
Due to player feedback that this mode is too time - consuming (it takes a great deal of time to obtain new weapons or characters each time), which thus affects their mood and game - playing experience, the following adjustments are now decided to be made.
1、Greatly reduce the difficulty of obtaining all weapons to enhance the game - playing experience.
2、Greatly reduce the difficulty of obtaining all characters to enhance the game - playing experience.

notes.title: Version 0.1.1 Update of "Fall"
notes.notes:
沦陷 v0.1.1 版本更新
根据上线以来玩家新一轮的反馈，对《沦陷》做出以下调整：
《进化》模式：
1、中立丧尸无法正常刷新问题进行了修复并增加了刷新率
2、中立丧尸模型进行优化，现在不同属性的丧尸会拥有符合自己能力的专属模型，不会在之前版本那么随机
3、对中立丧尸不攻击幸存者的问题进行修复
4、对中立丧尸能力偏弱进行了适当加强调整

《审判》模式
1、新增救援队到达提示

接下啦的工作预告：
1、根据玩家对《进化》模式的热情，目前正积极收取相关玩法建议与该模式下内容的部分问题，后续将加急完善，毕竟每一个原创模式的玩法都离不开热情玩家的支持。
2、第一人称模式的相关制作正在开发当中，请耐心等待，我们希望把最好的效果呈现给玩家。
3、steam成就系统已经正在制作当中

Version 0.1.1 Update of "Fall"
Based on the new round of feedback from players since the game went online, the following adjustments have been made to "Fall into Enemy Hands":

"Evolution" Mode:
1. The problem of the neutral zombies not being able to refresh properly has been fixed, and their refresh rate has been increased.
2. The neutral zombie models have been optimized. Now, zombies with different attributes will have their own exclusive models that match their abilities, not as random as in the previous version.
3. The problem of the neutral zombies not attacking survivors has been fixed.
4. The abilities of the neutral zombies, which were relatively weak, have been appropriately strengthened and adjusted.

"Judgment" Mode:
1. A new prompt for the arrival of the rescue team has been added.

Next Work Preview:
1. Given the players' enthusiasm for the "Evolution" mode, relevant gameplay suggestions and some problems regarding the content in this mode are currently being actively collected. Follow - up improvements will be expedited, because the gameplay of every original mode cannot do without the support of enthusiastic players.
2. The production related to the first - person mode is currently under development. Please be patient. We hope to present the best results to the players.
3. The Steam achievement system is already under production.

notes.notes:

You will play as an infected zombie and evolve into a lord before the city is nuked to withstand this devastating blow. This new mode is different from any mainstream gameplay at present. Its hit judgment and attack mechanism are not limited to the health bar, and its speed and attack power can also affect the gaming experience. We plan to release this mode in the official version as a major - version update on November 11th.
2. Meanwhile, the first - person mode is also under intense production.

notes.title: FALL v0.0.6 Update Notes
notes.notes:
根据上线以来玩家新一轮的反馈，对《沦陷》做出以下调整：
1、升级的时候为防止误点，延迟了技能卡出现的时间
2、增加救援队提示
3、修复部分主机卡死强退兼容性问题
4、新增《进化》模式菜单选择预览
5、本地化部分未翻译的文本

Based on the latest round of player feedback since release, adjustments have been made to "FALL" as follows:
1. During the upgrade, in order to prevent accidental clicks, the appearance time of the skill cards was delayed.
2. Add rescue team prompts.
3. Fix the compatibility problem of some hosts freezing and forced exit.
4. Add a preview of the "Evolution" mode menu selection.
5. Translate the untranslated local texts into English.

notes.title: FALL v0.0.5 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Based on the latest round of player feedback since release, adjustments have been made to "FALL" as follows:
1. Due to an overload of perpetual entities, some hosts are experiencing severe frame rate stuttering; therefore, a hidden model option has been added to the perpetual entity page.
2. A new game mode called "Evolution" has been introduced in the menu options.
3. The issue with points not being uploaded to the cloud after a victory in the cooperative mode has been resolved.

Upcoming Work Preview:
1. We are actively developing a first-person mode, aiming to deliver the best possible experience to our players.
2. Alongside this, we're working on an exciting zombie mode that will soon meet you all.
3. The implementation of the Steam achievements system is in progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833246/10be765e0af5cb5936c6ad01cd8d518ff0af93d3.png[/img]

notes.title: FALL v0.0.4 版本更新 Update Notes
notes.notes:
根据上线以来玩家新一轮的反馈，对《沦陷》做出以下调整：
1、修正亚空间生物过于变态的问题，减小刷新频率和适当减少数量
2、BOSS头上的血槽做出适当缩小与位置调整
3、现在TAB键能显示或隐藏底部基础操作的提示UI

接下啦的工作预告：
1、目前我们正在积极制作第一人称模式，希望把最好的效果呈现给玩家
2、除此之外，我们还在制作一个有趣的丧尸模式，即将与大家见面
3、steam成就系统正在安排当中

Based on the latest round of player feedback since release, adjustments have been made to "FALL" as follows:
1. The issue with abnormally powerful Subspace creatures has been addressed; their spawn frequency and quantity have been appropriately reduced.
2. The boss health bar size and position have been finely tuned for better gameplay balance.
3. The option to display or hide the basic operation UI at the bottom can now be toggled with the TAB key.

Upcoming Work Preview:
1. We are actively developing a first-person mode, aiming to deliver the best possible experience to our players.
2. Alongside this, we're working on an exciting zombie mode that will soon meet you all.
3. The implementation of the Steam achievements system is in progress.

notes.title: FALL v0.0.3 版本更新 version update
notes.notes:
根据上线以来玩家的反馈，对《FALL》做出以下调整：

1、增强自动攻击模式下角色对敌人的检测范围
2、取消关卡条件（现在可以进入已开放的任何一张地图而不需要前置条件）
3、增加机器人的攻击欲望
4、机器人出生时随机获取一把武器（自动步枪、霰弹枪、狙击枪里任意一把）
5、修复机器人贴到敌人时攻击没伤害问题
6、增强AI无人机和机器人判定能量
7、增强联动符咒攻击力

Based on player feedback since the launch, adjustments to "FALL" are as follows:

1. Enhance the character's detection range in auto-attack mode for enemies.
2. Remove level prerequisites (players can now access any unlocked map without prior conditions).
3. Increase the aggression of bots.
4. Bots will randomly acquire a weapon upon spawning (either an assault rifle, shotgun, or sniper rifle).
5. Fix the issue where bot attacks did no damage when in close contact with enemies.
6. Improve AI drone and bot energy determination.
7. Boost the attack power of linked talismans.
